name: Monster Battle Capture Loop
description: A Pokémon-inspired, single-encounter command loop: each side chooses a move, capture or switch; commands resolve by class, priority and speed; damage and status change capture odds; a successful throw routes the creature into party or box storage and registers it in the dex. Type effectiveness is a synchronous query rather than an event wire. Persistence, evolution, trainer battles and multi-creature battles are intentionally outside this first recipe.

components.role: known moves, move metadata and PP spending
simultaneous command collection and deterministic resolution order
active creature, voluntary switching and forced knockout replacement
durable party order and overflow box storage
encounter sides, creature stats and remaining health
synchronous elemental effectiveness and same-type bonus lookup
the single owner of final damage and defeat events
status application and the effects that alter capture odds
capture-device ownership, stacking and consumption boundary
one deterministic capture decision from current health, status, rarity and device
permanent caught registration and collection milestones
experience awarded for a defeating blow or knockout

connections.note: A validated move becomes one side's pending command.
PP is spent only when the command actually executes.
The round routes switching without owning party state.
The active creature and its speed are refreshed after a switch.
A capture command enters the same resolver as a direct throw input.
Final damage is computed in exactly one place.
Move effect payloads are applied independently of damage math.
The roster applies consequences to the authoritative unit state.
Capture odds read the latest remaining health.
A defeated creature leaves the active encounter roster.
A knockout triggers replacement or party defeat.
Eligible enemy knockouts award configured experience.
The round suspends further commands while replacement is pending.
Capture odds reflect the current status ledger.
One round heartbeat refreshes time-sensitive capture modifiers.
A caught creature enters the party or overflow storage exactly once.
The same successful result permanently registers the species.
A successful wild capture ends the encounter when configured.
A failed throw completes the command without granting ownership.
No healthy replacements means the encounter is lost.

acceptanceCriteria: No command resolves until every required side has submitted one, and a side cannot submit twice for the same round.
Commands resolve by configured class, then move priority, then active-creature speed; equal commands use the configured deterministic tie-break.
A rejected or unexecuted move spends no PP, while an executed move spends exactly one PP regardless of whether it hits.
Type effectiveness is obtained synchronously from combat.type_chart and final damage is emitted only by combat.damage_resolver.
A capture attempt consumes one owned device and resolves once against current health, status, rarity and device modifiers; shake presentation never rolls additional outcomes.
A successful capture adds one creature to party or box storage, registers one caught dex entry and emits no defeat reward for the captured target.
A failed capture grants no creature or dex entry and allows the configured round flow to continue.
A knockout requires a healthy replacement; if none exists, pets.battle_party emits pets.partyDefeated and the command round ends the encounter.
Removing pets.monster_dex does not prevent capture or party storage, and removing progression.xp_leveling does not prevent damage, capture or switching.
Replaying the same initial state, commands and seed produces the same command order, capture result and final ownership state.
